full_page.content:
1935, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 294 Cont.
Jan. 21 Eugenia Wyzlic - 26 - Gall-trouble three yrs. - now fears T.B ..... Asks prayers for Grandma ... to keep up.
Mrs. Mary Nelson - 79 - broke leg .... Elizabeth Swik - 24 - leakage of heart - had "flu" - mother anxious Magdl. Brown - 40 - that she come back to God and health .. . Brother Lucian. ..
Louis Paradis ... enemic - mental?
Hubert Boes - 27 - diabetis & T.B. - Mother fears operation Viola Youngblood - 34 - heart ...
Blank Page
Page 295 Page 296 Jan. Mary Jane Candler - 4 - bright beautiful child - can say only "Mama" Papa" me
Ruthie Smith - 7 - leakage of heart ... non Cath. - neighbor asks prayers for her.
Eliz. Dwyer - 40 - lump on breast- fears operation ....
24 Frank O'Donohue - 51 - in wreck 3 yrs. ago - now kidnies refuse to function - given up by all specialists. Enrolled at 6:15 p.m. Loretta McMillan - 44 - broke finger recently - already a cripple - doctors think it is
Franklin Van Buren - 8 - in kiefer Hosp. scarlet fever - mastoids - operated last Monday -
Mrs. France Curran - 43 - Applegate - Kidney trouble and weak heart - has 6 - 4 still going to school
Sister M. Cyril of Monroe - fears loss of Eye - was teaching here in St. Catherines - had to give up.
28 Sharon Shea - 7 mo. Jan. 28 - cerebral hemorages when 1 day old and throat paralysis- given up by all doctors. Then enrolled in Ser. Mass Asso'n and To-day in perfect health - a real "prize baby" Parents wish to thank God.
